title: Applications Support Sr Analyst - C12 - PUNE
description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

The Apps Support Sr Analyst is a seasoned professional role. Applies in-depth disciplinary knowledge, contributing to the development of new techniques and the improvement of processes and work-flow for the area or function. Integrates subject matter and industry expertise within a defined area. Requires in-depth understanding of how areas collectively integrate within the sub-function as well as coordinate and contribute to the objectives of the function and overall business. Evaluates moderately complex and variable issues with substantial potential impact, where development of an approach/taking of an action involves weighing various alternatives and balancing potentially conflicting situations using multiple sources of information. Requires good analytical skills in order to filter, prioritize and validate potentially complex and dynamic material from multiple sources. Strong communication and diplomacy skills are required. Regularly assumes informal/formal leadership role within teams. Involved in coaching and training of new recruits. Significant impact in terms of project size, geography, etc. by influencing decisions through advice, counsel and/or facilitating services to others in area of specialization. Work and performance of all teams in the area are directly affected by the performance of the individual.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* The Application Support Senior Analyst provides technical and business support for users of Citi Applcations. This includes providing quick resolutions to app issues, driving stability, efficiency and effectiveness improvements to help us and the business succeed.
* Maintains application systems that have completed the development stage and are running in the daily operations of the firm.
* Manages, maintains and supports applications and their operating environments, focusing on stability, quality and functionality against service level expectations.
* Start of day checks, continuous monitoring, and regional handover.
* Perform same day risk reconciliations
* Develop and maintain technical support documentation.
* Identifies ways to maximize the potential of the applications used
* Assess risk and impact of production issues and escalate to business and technology management in a timely manner.
* Ensures that storage and archiving procedures are in place and functioning correctly
* Formulates and defines scope and objectives for complex application enhancements and problem resolution
* Reviews and develops application contingency planning to ensure availability to users.
* Partners with appropriate development and production support areas to prioritize bug fixes and support tooling requirements.
* Participate in application releases, from development, testing and deployment into production.
* Engages in post implementation analysis to ensure successful system design and functionality.
* Considers implications of the application of technology to the current environment. Identifies risks, vulnerabilities and security issues; communicates impact.
* Ensures essential procedures are followed and helps to define operating standards and processes.
* Act as a liaison between users/traders, interfacing internal technology groups and vendors.
* Expected to be able to raise problems to appropriate technology and business teams, while adhering to Service Level Agreements.
* Acts as advisor or coach to new or lower level analysts.
* Provides evaluative judgment based on analysis of factual information in complicated and unique situations.
* Directly impacts the business by ensuring the quality of work provided by self and others; impacts own team and closely related work teams.
* Exhibits sound and comprehensive communication and diplomacy skills to exchange complex information.
* Active involvement in and ownership of Support Project items, covering Stability, Efficiency, and Effectiveness initiatives.
* Performs other duties and functions as assigned.
* Has the ability to operate with a limited level of direct supervision.
* Can exercise independence of judgement and autonomy.
* Acts as SME to senior stakeholders and /or other team members.
* Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.
  

  

**Recommended Qualifications:**

* 7-10 years experience in an Application Support role.
* Experience installing, configuring or supporting business applications.
* Experience with some programming languages and willingness/ability to learn.
* Advanced execution capabilities and ability to adjust quickly to changes and re-prioritization
* Effective written and verbal communications including ability to explain technical issues in simple terms that non-IT staff can understand.
* Demonstrated analytical skills
* Issue tracking and reporting using tools
* Knowledge/ experience of problem Management Tools.
* Good all-round technical skills
* Effectively share information with other support team members and with other technology teams
* Ability to plan and organize workload
* Consistently demonstrates clear and concise written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to communicate appropriately to relevant stakeholde
  

  

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s/University degree or equivalent experience
  

  

Requires experience and exposure to the following:

* Web Application architecture knowledge
* Understanding of microservices based applications
* API
* Should have good sql querying skillset
* Basics of Unix
* Exposure to Big Data - Hive/Impala/Spark
* Proficiency with Python will be added advantage.
* Exp in using Chrome Dev Tools, Kibana, Splunk
* Understanding of Kubernetes.
* Willing to work in shifts and weekends.

description:
**ICON INFOLINE PVT. LTD. (IIPL)**

**Job Title:** IT Recruiter / Talent Acquisition Executive  
**Department:** Human Resources  
**Location:** Pune  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time, On\-Site  
**Experience:** 1–2 Years, Interns can apply

About the Role

We are looking for a proactive and result\-oriented **IT Recruiter** to join our HR team at Icon Infoline Pvt. Ltd. The candidate will be responsible for managing end\-to\-end recruitment for IT, technical, sales, support and other business positions.

The ideal candidate should have strong sourcing and screening skills, good knowledge of IT/technical profiles, excellent communication skills, and the ability to manage multiple positions and candidates simultaneously.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage the **end\-to\-end recruitment process** from requirement understanding to candidate joining.
* Understand job requirements from hiring managers and prepare or refine Job Descriptions accordingly.
* Source candidates through **Naukri, LinkedIn, job portals, employee referrals, social media and other recruitment channels**.
* Identify and shortlist suitable candidates based on skills, experience, location, notice period and salary expectations.
* Conduct initial **HR screening and telephonic interviews**.
* Assess candidates for communication skills, stability, relevant experience and overall suitability.
* Coordinate technical and managerial interview rounds with the respective department heads.
* Maintain regular communication and follow\-up with candidates throughout the recruitment process.
* Manage candidate pipelines and ensure timely closure of open positions.
* Handle salary discussions, offer coordination and joining follow\-ups.
* Maintain accurate recruitment trackers, candidate databases and daily/weekly recruitment MIS.
* Ensure proper documentation of selected candidates before joining.
* Coordinate with HR for offer letters, joining formalities and onboarding.
* Develop and maintain a talent pool for frequently required IT and technical positions.
* Support bulk and urgent hiring requirements whenever required.
* Maintain a positive candidate experience throughout the recruitment cycle.

Profiles You May Handle

Recruitment may include positions such as:

* IT Support / Technical Support
* Network Engineers
* System / Infrastructure Engineers
* IT Sales \& Business Development
* Software / Application\-related profiles
* Data / Technical roles
* Back Office \& Operations
* Other IT and business support positions

Required Skills \& Qualifications

* Graduate degree in **HR, Business Administration, IT or a related field**.
* **1–2 years of experience in recruitment**, preferably IT/technical recruitment.
* Hands\-on experience with **Naukri and LinkedIn sourcing**.
* Good understanding of IT and technical job profiles.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Good candidate screening and interviewing skills.
* Ability to handle multiple vacancies simultaneously.
* Strong follow\-up, coordination and negotiation skills.
* Good knowledge of MS Excel / Google Sheets and recruitment trackers.
* Result\-oriented and comfortable working with recruitment targets and timelines.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Number of qualified profiles sourced and shortlisted.
* Interview\-to\-selection conversion.
* Offer\-to\-joining conversion.
* Recruitment turnaround time (TAT).
* Closure of assigned vacancies within timelines.
* Candidate database and tracker accuracy.
* Candidate follow\-up and joining ratio.

Preferred

* Experience in **IT Services / IT Infrastructure / Managed Services / Technical Support recruitment**.
* Experience handling multiple technical vacancies simultaneously.
* Knowledge of Boolean search and advanced sourcing techniques.
* Experience with ATS/HRMS or recruitment management systems.

**Reporting To:** HR Head / Management

#### **Your mission**


As a recruiter you are responsible for hiring best talents in time and offer a smooth candidate experience.


This role demands to support the structuration of recruitment and execute rigorously the policy.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Guarantee a clear reference frame in recruitment (recruitment policy, legal, key rules)
* Ensure every candidate has a good experience from hunt/application to onboarding
* Ensure managers apply successfully methodologies
* Support company in attractivity and employee brand
* Defining needs through a clear brief with managers
* Headhunting targeted profiles
* Assessing and evaluating candidates with a standard synthesis
* Support managers in decision making through debrief and score cards
* Ensuring every candidates get a feedback
* Pricing job offers

#### **You might be a great fit if…**

* You have a minimum of 5 years in recruitment including at least 3 years **headhunting** in PLM
* You have a bachelor or a master degree
* You are reliable, rigorous apply precisely methodologies and process defined
* You have an ability to synthesize information
* You conduct processes with proactivity, assertiveness and advisory approach to support managers
* You have good oral communication (clear, structured, concise \& synthetic, precise)
* You have good editorial communication
